import numpy as np, mujoco, casa_tool
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation

s = casa_tool.Session('/app/instance.npz')
m,d=s.model,s.data
jidx=np.array([m.joint('robot0_joint'+str(i)).qposadr[0] for i in range(1,8)])
lo=np.array([m.joint('robot0_joint'+str(i)).range[0] for i in range(1,8)])+.01
hi=np.array([m.joint('robot0_joint'+str(i)).range[1] for i in range(1,8)])-.01
sid=m.site('gripper0_right_grip_site').id
ori=d.site_xmat[sid].reshape(3,3).copy()
work=mujoco.MjData(m)
grip=-1.0

def ee(): return d.site_xpos[sid].copy()
def obj(n): return d.xpos[m.body(n+'_main').id].copy()
def solve(pos,mat=ori):
    q0=d.qpos[jidx].copy(); work.qpos[:]=d.qpos;work.qvel[:]=d.qvel
    def f(q):
        work.qpos[jidx]=q;mujoco.mj_forward(m,work)
        xyz=work.site_xpos[sid];rot=work.site_xmat[sid].reshape(3,3)
        er=Rotation.from_matrix(mat@rot.T).as_rotvec()
        return np.r_[12*(xyz-pos),1.5*er,.04*(q-q0)]
    res=least_squares(f,np.clip(q0,lo,hi),bounds=(lo,hi),max_nfev=100)
    return res.x

def act(q=None,g=None,bx=0,mode=-1):
    global grip
    if g is not None:grip=g
    a=np.zeros(13);a[:7]=d.qpos[jidx] if q is None else q;a[7]=grip;a[8]=bx;a[12]=mode
    return s.step(a)

def hold(n,q=None,g=None):
    for _ in range(n): act(q,g)

def move(pos,n=25,g=None):
    q=solve(np.array(pos));hold(n,q,g)
    print('move',np.round(pos,3),'ee',np.round(ee(),3),'err',np.round(ee()-pos,3),'steak',np.round(obj('steak'),3),'aspar',np.round(obj('asparagus'),3),'check',s.check()['success'],flush=True)
